So I have been to a fair few GPs all over England, considering I move a lot, and I must say this one is THE BEST.

I have been recently diagnosed with server anxiety and panic attacks that came due to life traumas but mostly they came out of no where during my sleep.

It all started with tremours.

Since changing my GP to Dr Phillips I have had nothing but amazing support.

They listen so well.

Sally is a great listener and really supportive in guiding me in my next steps and making me feel comfortable.

Dr. Phillips is very honest in his practice and helped me in a few decision making (which I asked for) based around real life situations with not having a job and suffering with stress and my heart issues. Sometimes I find doctors just subscribe things and leave you to get on with it. However Dr. Phillips really considers everything at hand.

As for Jill! Thank you so much for being there to calm me down when I had my panic attack and I had no where to go. For being so calming and caring and telling me about the spoons theory!

Even Kim , did an excellent job taking my blood samples and ECG ! I am normally a fainter and squirm at the thought of needles. Kim was so fast , yet calm and efficient, gave me a chocolate rice cake and off I popped. No more than 10 min.

Also the staff behind the pharmacy counter have all been exceptional and on time. I never wait more than two minutes. Always encouraging and validating too.

I heard there have been some changes, whatever the changes I so approve and this is the standard that should be set all over England. And in the world in my humble opinion.

It's rare of me to leave such a review. But felt it was only right to leave an honest one.

I hope you all have a safe and blessed day",null,[0,114]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VQbnI1ZERWMXB2U1RREAE!2m1!1s0x0:0xe4f8d2cada0fbd40!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEPnr5dDV1pvSTQ%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VQbnI1ZERWMXB2U1RREAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VQbnI1ZERWMXB2U1RREi0KFkNJSE0wb2dLRU5pVnZyaXM3OFRzVEESE0Nnd0lfNmpjd1FZUTBQTFotd0UaLQoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFT3pDMVA3dndJTHZJdxITQ2d3SXlLYmN3UVlRNEtpM3NBTSISCQAAAAAAAAAAEUC9D9rK0vjkKhNDZ3dJXzZqY3dRWVEwUExaLXdF&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjpvpKh3LKTAxURMnsEHRjHBhAQoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjpvpKh3LKTAxURMnsEHRjHBhAQ0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUpSVlc5ZlgxOWZSV2hFY1VONlJHUmlkekZwWlhsdGRGOUdiMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEppVFVOaFQycFlOMlJuV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNuNllDc2pnRRAB",["0x0:0xe4f8d2cada0fbd40",null,1727435846876453,1727435846876453,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/115139180637613368501/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Annabelle Margolis","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU9e0tvZ2ZUD1H6FLMTpAk5tdRMTfYeL8hlYVT4ND9ELxl1irMD=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/115139180637613368501?hl=en"],"115139180637613368501",null,39,15,null,[1,5,1],0,["Local Guide · 39 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjpvpKh3LKTAxURMnsEHRjHBhAQ7LoGCBIoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Really terrible show yesterday.
